title: Women Training Completion and Employment Rates – Purnia vs Nalanda (2023)
question: Why is Purnia’s completion and employment rates lower than Nalanda’s in 2023, and what intervention could help?

view.title: Women Training Completion and Employment Rates – Purnia vs Nalanda (2023)
view.note: Completion rate is the proportion of women who completed training out of those enrolled. Employment rate is the proportion of women employed at 6 months out of those enrolled.

insight_specs.message: The data set contains only aggregate counts for 2023 and does not include variables that could explain the observed differences. Therefore, a causal explanation cannot be derived from this single dataset.

insights.label: What this data cannot answer
insights.text: This file shows differences and changes, but it has no explanatory variables and cannot establish why they occurred.
